eval.title: Buy BlackRock Stock For a Quick 2x!

call.headline_quote: However, I have just this value investing thing in me that doesn't allow me to make money on that.

base_metric.name: dps
base_metric.quote: the dividend doubles from the current to 20 to 40 bucks, that's it.

scenarios.name: normal
scenarios.quote: 15% per year, as I said, growth. If they continue it, that's 2x in five years.

what_is_priced_in.quote: at these valuations, the P ratio is 30 maybe. So that's all good. If you look at the adjusted is 20 for what was it 10% 15% dividend growth going forward.

reasons.claim: Buffett has moved to cash in 2025, signaling he believes the era of ignoring price and just buying passive/alternative products is ending.
reasons.quote: he's completely in cash now 2025. We don't know whether the party might finish, but he assumes that the party will finish.

reasons.claim: Icahn's long-standing warning that ETFs are overpriced and illiquid and could blow up remains a real risk that would also hit BlackRock.
reasons.quote: ETFs are overpriced and extremely illquid. He thinks that they are going to blow up and that can happen. ETFs can blow up and Black Rockck can blow up.

reasons.claim: A repeat of the early-1970s scenario, where the market fell 60% in real terms and took 20 years to recover, would end BlackRock's growth story, and today's much higher debt-to-GDP leaves less room for government rescue.
reasons.quote: 10 years later, the market was down 60%... To get to zero from the market, you had to wait 20 years.

data_check.gap_note: not in our data: debt to GDP, debt to GDP

reasons.claim: BlackRock's fee-on-AUM model wins in every macro environment, whether markets rise, rates fall, or money is printed and inflates assets.
reasons.quote: So whatever happens, crisis, lower rates, money printing, Black Rockck makes money. Great economy, everything goes up, Black Rockck makes money.

data_check.gap_note: trajectory visible at T0; no number stated

reasons.claim: At a P/E of roughly 30 (20 on adjusted earnings) with 15% dividend growth, the stock could plausibly double as the dividend doubles.
reasons.quote: If we compare it to the price, well at these valuations, the P ratio is 30 maybe. So that's all good.

external_facts_used: Larry Fink's investor day 2030 aspiration of $35 billion revenue and a stated goal to double market cap
Ken Griffin's comment calling tokenization an opportunity for 'shysters'
Paul Tudor Jones's comments on levered ETFs proliferating and expecting BlackRock/NASDAQ to double in 6-12 months
BlackRock's ~$19-20 billion offer for global ports from CK Hutchison
Carl Icahn's decade-old warnings that ETFs are overpriced and illiquid
Warren Buffett's 1985 shareholder letter on institutions ignoring business value
Historical US stock market real returns from the late 1960s/1970s

critic.notes: ok — the 'best buy, sell everything else' line is irony; he places BLK as high risk on the quadrant and says his value investing doesn't allow him to buy it, so avoid/SELL matches.
